test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which sentence contains a misspelled word?

options.text: She skillfully segued into the next topic
His presentation segued smoothly from one idea to another.
He seegued into a completely different subject halfway through.
The discussion will segue into a Q&A session.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. He seegued into a completely different subject halfway through. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"segue"** is a verb that means to transition smoothly from one topic or section to another.
 
• In the sentence provided in option 3, the word **"seegued"** is misspelled. The correct spelling is **"segued"**.
 
• This makes option 3 the sentence containing the misspelled word.

Correct sentence: *He **segued** into a completely different subject halfway through.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common Context for "Segue":**
 
 
• The word is often used in speeches, presentations, and conversations to describe a smooth transition.
 
• Example: *The speaker seamlessly **segued** from one topic to another.*
 
 
 
• **Other Forms:**
 
 
• Present tense: segue
 
• Past tense: segued
 
• Continuous tense: segueing
